How to host it yourself

Two ways to run it

You host it

Take the finished files to whatever host you like — Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, GitHub Pages, or plain shared hosting. Your bill, your control, and we are not in the loop.

We host it

$79 a month and you never think about it again. We deploy it, keep it online, apply updates, and answer when something needs changing. Cancel whenever you like.

What is included, and what is not

What exactly do I get for the $500?
A complete site: your pages, your words, your photos, built and tested on a phone and on a desktop. You get the finished files, permanently. The first year of hosting and management is included, so the first thing you pay after that is optional.
Is the monthly payment mandatory?
No. Hosting and management is a service, not a lock. Take the files to another host and stop paying whenever you like — the site keeps working. That is the difference between this and a site builder.
Do you take a cut of my sales?
No. There is no checkout on your site at launch — we link out to wherever you already sell, and you keep your existing payment setup and your own customer relationships.
Do you do marketing as well?
Not as part of the monthly. The site is built to be found: it repeats your address and opening hours exactly, and it carries the machine-readable details search engines read. Marketing and SEO is a separate service if you want it.
What if I need changes later?
Small ones you can make yourself from a simple admin screen — words, colours, photos, at no cost. Bigger changes are what the monthly covers, and anything beyond that we will quote.
Can I see it before I commit?
Yes. The builder on this site lets you assemble a page and read it live without an account or a card. It is the same engine we would use to build yours.

Tell us what you need

Fifteen minutes is enough to say whether a new site is what you need, and what it would cost. No pitch, and no obligation.
